quantity: Monthly SPEI-12 anomaly, not long-term event frequency
temporal_statistic: One monthly observation of 12-month accumulation; baseline fit must be pinned
spatial_support: Native source grid; CSIC historical reference is 0.5 degree

class_meanings.none: SPEI > -1; no classified dry anomaly for this observation

rationale: Propose dry-event severity mapping from Copernicus Table 2: extremely dry -> high, very dry -> medium, moderately dry -> low, all values > -1 -> none of this dry-event signal. Wet anomalies are not absence of other hazards. This is a proposed event-level interpretation, not a calibrated T5 climatological surface.
alternatives: Use a different SPEI accumulation window only through a separately scoped rule.
Treat event severity as descriptive until long-term priority statistic is agreed.
blockers: CSIC v2.6 asset, reference fit, fill values and baseline period unverified
T5 frequency/severity reducer not defined; event rule cannot activate current T5
Pilot context and target-period applicability not accepted
